about: Manual adjudication of findings that match no planted issue. Each was checked against the case text and source PDF page. Adjudicated by the team (prepared by Claude Code, to be confirmed by Harshal Yeole). Keyed by base case so the same finding is judged the same way in every variant and run.

items.key: inconsistency|dob: pob: nigeria entered as a b-1/b2 arriving on 06- 01-201|entry.date
items.note: S29 describes a second person (a B-1/B-2 arrival on 06-01-2016), not this record's subject, whose entry 12/23/2015 matches the form.

items.key: inconsistency|at 0412 am sector dispatch requested a supervisory border pa|encounter.date_time
